sets.title: 再 vs 在
sets.rule: 在 = WHERE something is (我在家). 再 = AGAIN, and always in the future (再见).

sets.title: 买 vs 卖
sets.rule: 卖 has an extra 十 on top — that lid is the shop sign, so goods go OUT. No lid = 买, goods come IN.

sets.title: 他 vs 她 vs 它
sets.rule: Same sound tā, different left side: 亻person = he, 女woman = she, 宀roof = it. Nobody can hear the difference; only writing shows it.

sets.title: 的 vs 得 vs 地
sets.rule: 的 + noun (我的书). 得 + how well (跑得快). 地 + verb (慢慢地走).

sets.title: 会 vs 能 vs 可以
sets.rule: 会 = learned skill (我会开车). 能 = physically able right now (我今天不能开车). 可以 = allowed (你可以开我的车).

sets.title: 知道 vs 认识
sets.rule: 知道 = know a FACT. 认识 = know a PERSON or a character by sight. 我知道他，但是我不认识他。

sets.title: 觉得 vs 认为
sets.rule: 觉得 = a feeling, softer, personal. 认为 = a considered opinion, used in writing and arguments.

sets.title: 就 vs 才
sets.rule: 就 = sooner/easier than expected (他七点就来了). 才 = later/harder than expected (他九点才来).

sets.title: 有 vs 在
sets.rule: 有 puts the THING second (桌子上有书). 在 puts the PLACE second (书在桌子上).

sets.title: 只 zhī vs 只 zhǐ
sets.rule: Same character, two jobs. zhī (1st tone) = measure word for animals. zhǐ (3rd tone) = only.

sets.title: 还 hái vs 还 huán
sets.rule: hái = still, yet (他还没来). huán = to give back (我把书还给图书馆).

sets.title: 又 vs 再
sets.rule: 又 for something that already happened again (他又迟到了). 再 for something that will happen again (明天再来).

sets.title: 一起 vs 一共
sets.rule: 一起 = together, side by side. 一共 = altogether, a total count.

sets.title: 一直 vs 一定
sets.rule: 一直 = continuously, the whole time. 一定 = definitely, for sure.

sets.title: 或者 vs 还是
sets.rule: Use 还是 when you are ASKING (茶还是咖啡?). Use 或者 when you are TELLING (茶或者咖啡都可以).

sets.title: 完 vs 玩
sets.rule: Identical sound wán. 完 has a roof (宀) = finished. 玩 has jade (王) = playing with a toy.

sets.title: 白 vs 百
sets.rule: 百 is 白 with a lid (一) on top: one hundred. Without the lid it is white.

sets.title: 大 vs 太
sets.rule: 太 is 大 with a dot underneath. The dot is the extra bit that makes it "too much".

sets.title: 睡觉 jiào vs 觉得 jué
sets.rule: Same character 觉. In 睡觉 it is jiào (sleep). In 觉得 it is jué (to sense).

sets.title: 音乐 yuè vs 快乐 lè
sets.rule: Same character 乐. Music = yuè. Happy = lè.

sets.title: 银行 háng vs 行李 xíng
sets.rule: Same character 行. háng = a line of business (bank). xíng = to go/travel (luggage).

sets.title: 教室 jiào vs 教 jiāo
sets.rule: jiāo (1st tone) = the act of teaching. jiào (4th tone) = education, as in classroom/teacher.

sets.title: 请 / 清楚 / 晴 / 事情
sets.rule: All built on 青 qīng. The left side tells you the meaning: 讠speech=ask, 氵water=clear, 日sun=fine weather, 忄heart=feeling.

sets.title: 是 shì / 十 shí / 时候 shí / 试 shì / 认识 shí
sets.rule: The shi family. Only the tone separates them: 是 and 试 are 4th tone, 十 时 识 are 2nd tone.

sets.title: 上 vs 下
sets.rule: 上 = the line ABOVE the base. 下 = the line BELOW. Everything else (上班/下班, 上午/下午, 上车/下车) follows from that picture.

sets.title: 左边 vs 右边
sets.rule: 左 has 工 (work) inside; 右 has 口 (mouth) inside. Your mouth is on the right when you speak into a phone.

sets.title: 高 vs 矮
sets.rule: 高 is a tall tower. 矮 has 矢 (a short arrow) — it never grew.

sets.title: 胖 vs 瘦
sets.rule: 胖 has 月 (flesh) plus 半. 瘦 wears the sickness radical 疒 — too thin.

sets.title: 长 vs 短
sets.rule: 长 is flowing hair. 短 has 矢, the arrow that fell short.

sets.title: 新 vs 旧
sets.rule: 新 has 斤 (an axe) — freshly cut. 旧 is worn out. For PEOPLE use 老, never 旧.

sets.title: 快 vs 慢
sets.rule: Both have the heart radical 忄. A racing heart is 快; a heavy heart is 慢.

sets.title: 多 vs 少
sets.rule: 多 is two piles stacked. 少 is 小 with a stroke taken away.

sets.title: 冷 vs 热
sets.rule: 冷 has two ice drops 冫. 热 has four fire dots 灬.

sets.title: 开 vs 关
sets.rule: 开 = two hands throwing the doors open. 关 = a bolt across the gate. Also 开灯/关灯, 开机/关机.

sets.title: 进 vs 出
sets.rule: 进 walks (辶) in. 出 is a foot stepping out of a cave, twice.

sets.title: 难 vs 容易 vs 简单
sets.rule: 难 = hard. 容易 = easy to do. 简单 = simple in structure. A question can be 简单 but still 难 if you never studied.

sets.title: 便宜 vs 贵
sets.rule: 贵 has the shell 贝 (old money) at the bottom — it costs a lot.

sets.title: 早上 vs 晚上
sets.rule: 早 = the sun just above the horizon. 晚 = the sun already gone.

sets.title: 前面 vs 后面
sets.rule: 前 is what your feet face; 后 is what your back faces.

sets.title: 男 vs 女
sets.rule: 男 = 田 field + 力 strength. 女 = a kneeling figure with crossed arms.

sets.title: 问 vs 回答
sets.rule: 问 = a mouth 口 inside a gate 门. 回答 = the answer coming back 回.

sets.title: 借 vs 还
sets.rule: 借 covers BOTH borrow and lend — the direction comes from the sentence. 还 (huán) is always giving back.

sets.title: 忘记 vs 记得
sets.rule: Both contain 记 (to record). 忘 adds 亡 (lost) over 心 (heart) — the record fell out of your heart.

sets.title: 突然 vs 当然 vs 然后
sets.rule: All end in 然. 突然 = suddenly. 当然 = of course. 然后 = and then.

sets.title: 才 vs 刚才
sets.rule: 才 = only then, later than expected. 刚才 = a moment ago. 刚才 is a time word; 才 is an adverb.

sets.title: 一般 vs 一边
sets.rule: 般 bān = a sort/kind (usually). 边 biān = a side (一边…一边… = at the same time).

sets.title: 其实 vs 其他
sets.rule: 实 = reality → actually. 他 = other → the others.

sets.title: 决定 vs 解决
sets.rule: Both use 决. 决定 = to decide. 解决 = to un-tie (解) a problem.

sets.title: 结婚 vs 结束
sets.rule: Both use 结 (to tie). 婚 = marriage. 束 = to bind up, so 结束 = to wrap it up, to end.

sets.title: 关系 vs 关心 vs 关于
sets.rule: All start with 关. 系 = connection (a relationship). 心 = heart (to care). 于 = at (about, concerning).

sets.title: 生气 vs 天气
sets.rule: Both end in 气 (air). 生气 = the air you generate = anger. 天气 = the air of the sky = weather.

sets.title: 影响 vs 电影
sets.rule: Both use 影 (shadow). 电影 = electric shadow = film. 影响 = shadow + echo = influence.

sets.title: 重要 vs 主要 vs 需要 vs 要求
sets.rule: All contain 要. 重要 = heavy → important. 主要 = main. 需要 = to need. 要求 = to demand.

sets.title: 注意 / 意思 / 同意 / 满意 / 愿意
sets.rule: All contain 意 (idea). 注意 = pour your attention. 意思 = meaning. 同意 = same idea = agree. 满意 = full idea = satisfied. 愿意 = wish + idea = willing.

sets.title: 着急 vs 担心
sets.rule: 着急 = anxious about time, right now. 担心 = worried about someone or something, over a longer period.

sets.title: 自己 vs 自行车
sets.rule: Both start with 自 (self). 己 = self. 行车 = a going vehicle → the bicycle you power yourself.

sets.title: 最近 vs 附近
sets.rule: Both use 近 (near). 最近 = nearest in TIME = recently. 附近 = nearby in SPACE.

sets.title: 作业 vs 作用 vs 工作
sets.rule: All use 作 (to do). 业 = task → homework. 用 = use → effect. 工 = labour → work.

sets.title: 教室 vs 办公室 vs 洗手间
sets.rule: 室 = a room for a purpose. 间 = a space between walls. Both are rooms; 室 sounds more institutional.

sets.title: 中间 / 时间 / 房间 / 洗手间
sets.rule: All use 间 (a gap between two things). Middle, a gap of time, a gap in a house, the washing room.

sets.title: 照顾 vs 照片 vs 照相机
sets.rule: All start with 照 (to shine). 顾 = to look after. 片 = a flat slice = photo. 相机 = image machine = camera.

sets.title: 同事 vs 故事 vs 事情
sets.rule: All contain 事 (matter). 同事 = same-matter person = colleague. 故事 = old matters = a story.

sets.title: 衣服 vs 舒服
sets.rule: Both end in 服 fu. 衣服 = clothes. 舒服 = comfortable. 服 originally means "to wear / to submit to".

sets.title: 干净 vs 安静
sets.rule: jìng vs jìng — same sound, different characters. 净 = clean (water radical). 静 = quiet.

sets.title: 现在 vs 正在
sets.rule: 现在 is a TIME WORD (now). 正在 is an ADVERB placed before a verb (他正在吃饭 = he is eating right now).

sets.title: 想 vs 要 vs 需要 vs 愿意
sets.rule: 想 = would like to. 要 = want / must (stronger). 需要 = need. 愿意 = willing to.

sets.title: 来 vs 去
sets.rule: 来 = toward the speaker. 去 = away from the speaker. The speaker's position decides, not the map.

sets.title: 站 vs 坐
sets.rule: 站 = to stand (and a bus stop). 坐 = to sit (and to travel by vehicle: 坐飞机).

sets.title: 提高 vs 高兴
sets.rule: Both contain 高. 提高 = to lift up = to improve. 高兴 = high spirits = happy.

sets.title: 客人 vs 别人
sets.rule: 客 = guest. 别 = other. 别人 also means "somebody else" in general.

sets.title: 终于 vs 中国
sets.rule: 终 (end) and 中 (middle) look and sound close: zhōng both. 终于 = at last; 中 = middle.

sets.title: 本 vs 书
sets.rule: 书 is the book itself (a noun). 本 is how you COUNT books (一本书).

sets.title: 吧 vs 把
sets.rule: 吧 has the mouth 口 — it is a spoken particle. 把 has the hand 扌 — it grabs the object.
